data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat trip in 2037 but don't have a boating licence? No problem. All our charters include a professional skipper, so you can enjoy the Costa del Sol without any paperwork. Prices start from €749 for 2 hours on a 12.5m Astondoa 40, and go up to €4,719 for 4 hours on a 24m Mangusta 80 with a free jet ski. Every rental includes fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. Here's your complete guide to marbella boat rental no license prices 2037.

No Licence Needed – How It Works

Spanish law requires a recreational boating licence for vessels over 5 metres or with engines over 15 HP. But when you charter a boat with a skipper, the licence requirement is bypassed. The skipper handles navigation, docking, and safety – you just relax. All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's most famous marina.

2037 Price Overview – No-License Rentals

We have two pricing tiers for no-license rentals in 2037. Tier A covers smaller motor yachts at fixed rates. Tier B covers larger vessels with a minimum 4-hour booking. For other yachts, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp.

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA. No hidden extras.

What's Included in Every Charter

  • Licensed skipper (no licence needed for you)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • 21% Spanish IVA (VAT)

Best Boats for a No-Licence Day Out

For a group of up to 9, the Astondoa 40 is a popular choice at €749 for 2 hours. If you have 11 friends, the Azimut 39 offers similar pricing with more space. For a premium experience, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski – perfect for 2037 holidays. All depart from Puerto Banús.

What to Expect on the Water

Typical itineraries include cruising past the Golden Mile, anchoring at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, and stopping for a swim. The skipper will tailor the route to your group. Average sea temperatures in Marbella range from 16°C in winter to 26°C in summer, so 2037 will be just as inviting.

How to Book for 2037

Booking is simple. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), you can reserve online or via WhatsApp. For larger yachts like the Mangusta 80, contact us on WhatsApp for availability and custom quotes. All prices are fixed and include the extras listed above. No licence, no stress – just a great day on the Costa del Sol.

The cheapest option is the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 at €749 for 2 hours (skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks included).

Yes. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are available for 8 hours at €2,299. Larger yachts like the Mangusta 80 start at €4,719 for 4 hours.

What is included in the no-license boat rental price?

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% IVA.

Where do the boats depart from?

All boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella. You can also arrange pick-ups from Marbella Marina or nearby ports.

How many people can go on a no-license boat rental?

Capacity ranges from 5 passengers (Dubhe 8m) up to 12 passengers (Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, Ferretti 94, and others).

Can I bring my own food and drinks?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks. The included drinks and snacks are provided as standard.

How do I book a no-license boat rental for 2037?
